captions.body:
🏝️ SAMANA COLLECTA — World Islands flagship

SAMANA announced a new island residential development on 15 October 2026 under its COLLECTA premium brand.

• The World Islands, Dubai; exact island plot pending
• 840 branded residences, from studios to 4-bedroom homes
• Seven floating villas and two tree villas
• Planned beaches, lagoon, beach club and co-working spaces
• Project name and Italian brand partner still to be revealed

Official starting price, payment plan and EOI terms: not released. The CEO indicates four years from construction start; a calendar handover date is not yet confirmed.

Broker angle: a new island-living option to shortlist before the full sales pack is released; transport and operating costs will be important checks.

Confidence: confirmed announcement, not confirmed sales opening.

https://graf.ae/launches/samana-collecta-world-islands/

🏙️ The Bay Interiors by Missoni — Tomorrow World

Official update: Tomorrow World and Missoni confirmed the project’s pre-launch on 15 October 2026.

• Main yacht marina, Island A, Dubai Islands
• Adjacent to the yacht club
• Preliminary collection: 2- and 3-bedroom residences plus signature penthouses
• Interiors by Missoni
• Exclusively presented by OCTA Properties

OCTA’s wider project listing describes 132 homes across 2–4BR configurations; the exact released inventory is still awaited.

Official price list, payment/EOI terms and contractual handover: pending confirmation. A public sales-opening date has not been announced.

Broker angle: the confirmed marina position strengthens the waterfront shortlist while we await comparable unit prices and layouts.

Confidence: high on the announcement and location; commercial terms remain unconfirmed.

https://graf.ae/launches/tomorrow-world-the-bay-interiors-by-missoni/
